description: Which RunPod data centers count for Podlight's hosting choices. Matched by ID prefix, so data centers RunPod adds later in the same countries are included. RunPod treats dataCenterIds only as a preference (OpenAPI CreatePodRequest, 2026-11-21) and its DPA guarantees no data residency, so Podlight checks where a pod actually landed and deletes it if it is outside.
source: Data center IDs from RunPod's catalog and https://getdeploying.com/runpod (2026-11-21); countries inferred from the IDs.
